long_biography.plain_text:
Interprogressbank was the clearest financial asset in Andrei Viktorovich Krapivin's low-profile business career. He owned 28.67% of the Moscow bank and was recognised for his knowledge of banking. Krapivin also entered railway-industry governance, joining the boards of Rusagrotrans and Transmashholding in 2008. He later worked as an adviser to the president of Russian Railways.

Krapivin died in Switzerland in April 2015. His Interprogressbank stake then passed to his son Aleksei. The son subsequently controlled railway-construction businesses and led Group 1520, roles that should not be attributed to Andrei. No current operating role or holding therefore exists for the elder Krapivin. His bank ownership and board work are clear, but his birth details and the original source of his investment capital remain unresolved.
